description: This header file defines the API for freezing Torchscript modules within the PyTorch JIT compiler. It provides functions to produce frozen modules, which assume all attributes are constants, thereby enabling more aggressive optimizations such as inlining and attribute internalization. The API supports both a cloning approach and an inplace modification approach.

methods.name: freeze_module
methods.description: Creates a frozen clone of the provided module, internalizing attributes and applying optimizations. It accepts optional parameters for preserved attributes, whether to freeze interfaces, and whether to preserve parameters.

methods.name: freeze_module_inplace
methods.description: Modifies the given module in place to freeze it, internalizing attributes and optimizing without cloning, with optional parameters similar to freeze_module.
